findings.issue: The proposal combines an already implemented standard pre-cart quote with a potential pre-cart negotiation assessment. Only the first has an approved existing authority path. Simulating persisted negotiation before a cart would introduce new concession/event-consumption semantics, not merely expose missing context.

findings.requiredCorrection: Remove new pre-cart negotiation/concession assessment from this repair. Reuse quote_product/read_policy and existing evaluateShopPolicy; expose source-derived parent-unit count/basis from the actual calculation where needed, not a second promotion engine or hard-coded5%. Keep missing-negotiation result UNKNOWN. Avoid creating a cart just to answer a price objection.
findings.ownerDecisionIfExpanded: Offering or reserving negotiated concessions before a cart requires an explicit business/event-ledger/expiry/consumption decision and new plan; not assumed authorized.

findings.issue: Removing the contradictory tool declaration is justified, but sourceQuote existence, current-message binding or an owner-issued enum cannot prove semantic purchase intent. The verifier runs after effects and cannot undo an unwanted cart mutation. A plan that calls those fields authorization proof repeats prior metadata-as-authority errors.

evidence.detail: add_to_cart declaration says chosen offer/size→call directly, competing with owner prompt explicitly distinguishing referent clarification from purchase.
Effect authorization and operation identity bind current scope/source message; that is not independent semantic consent evidence.

findings.requiredCorrection: Fix the competing declaration at its origin; keep read_product/customerSelected or existing retained-selection path as read/selection only, and keep clear purchase add_to_cart fast path. Do not add fields falsely labeled code-verified buying intent or use the post-effect verifier as a hidden pre-effect role. Acceptance must be behavioral: whole paired dialogues produce zero cart/CAS/event/receipt in the informational arm and exactly one correct cart change in the genuine buying arm, including a short answer completing a prior explicit buy request. This measures owner behavior; residual semantic intent risk remains even if observed cases pass.
findings.ownerDecisionIfExpanded: If owner requires deterministic prevention rather than measured behavior, a code-owned customer confirmation/postback flow or separately authorized pre-effect semantic design is needed. That changes UX/architecture and needs owner decision; do not silently force extra confirmation for every explicit buy.

findings.issue: A customer-wearing request value is a useful domain constraint, but adding the enum cannot create source provenance or close the case where the owner incorrectly requests ordinary FEEDBACK. The actual stable image schema has no wearer-provenance field and descriptionEvidence unconditionally emits NOT_RECORDED.

evidence.detail: customerWearingEvidence is always NOT_RECORDED for every selected asset.
Current intent surface has FEEDBACK but no customer-wearing requirement.
Strict stable image schema has feedback/review/hash metadata; no verified customer-wearing provenance.
Actual verifier saw latest wearing request, final feedback reply and NOT_RECORDED limits, yet passed the implication.

findings.requiredCorrection: Implement a truthful negative requirement path only in this revision: one narrow expressed customer-wearing requirement in the existing media tool (not both a new intent and redundant flag), check existing source metadata and report required provenance NOT_RECORDED/unavailable; use existing silent handoff recovery. Generic FEEDBACK remains usable for genuine feedback-only requests. Do not fabricate positive provenance or weaken this failed case by relabeling it. Explicitly retain the semantic omission risk when owner sends FEEDBACK/GENERIC instead; mandatory verifier must still evaluate the whole dialogue and exact reply, with safety controls for the observed implication. Source-gap is outside sales quality, not outside safety.
findings.ownerDecisionIfExpanded: Positive wearer capability requires an approved actual asset/provenance source, subject/component/hash/approval binding and schema/producer/consumer plan. Until then report not implemented; no mass data rewrite or synthetic wearer fact.

findings.issue: Deduplicating by choosing one parent image would remove source/subject coverage and may bypass revocation for the other parent. The duplication is caused by combining identity and physical send dedup, not missing metadata.

findings.requiredCorrection: Separate physical attachment list from complete selected evidence. Dedup only identical canonical URL plus source-content hash; retain every validated parent/source proof for opening coverage, protected claims and delivery binding. findings.ownerDecisionIfExpanded: A new shared coverage schema is not obviously required for same-asset proof preservation. If actual consumers require one-to-one image/message binding, amend that exact contract and test it rather than dropping proof.
